newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi Sec says to cut monthly costs by Y2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi Sec says to cut monthly costs by Y2 bln.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd said on Friday it would reduce its monthly costs by two billion yen per month from September, mainly by cutting back spending on the management of its computer system.
A company spokesman said the brokerage's monthly costs totalled 15.8 billion yen in the first half of fiscal 1997/98.
Another spokesman said the planned savings would mainly be made on computer system management handled by a Yamaichi's group computer firm, but would also include other measures.
